fullPassage: The mind has parts that are known as the conscious mind and the subconscious mind. The subconscious mind is very fast to act and doesn't deal with emotions. It deals with memories of your responses to life, your memories and recognition. However, the conscious mind is the one that you have more control over. You think. You can choose whether to carry on a thought or to add emotion to it and this is the part of your mind that lets you down frequently because— fueled by emotions— you make the wrong decisions time and time again. When your judgment is clouded by emotions, this puts in biases and all kinds of other negativities that hold you back. Scared of spiders? Scared of the dark? There are reasons for all of these fears, but they originate in the conscious mind. They only become real fears when the subconscious mind records your reactions.

❌ ② slow — clouded — originate: (A) slow(느린)는 fast(빠른)와 반대
❌ ③ fast — cleared — originate: (B) cleared(맑아진)는 clouded(흐려진)와 반대
❌ ④ fast — clouded — end: (C) end(끝나다)는 originate(비롯되다)와 반대

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the ability to make good decisions or form sensible opinions"

det.korean: judgment=판단(력) (좋은 결정을 내리거나 분별 있는 의견을 형성하는 능력)
det.analysis:
❌ ① recognition: recognition(인식)은 판단력이 아닌 알아보는 능력
✅ ② judgment: judgment(판단력)는 좋은 결정을 내리거나 분별 있는 의견을 형성하는 능력으로 영영 정의에 정확히 일치 ←정답
❌ ③ emotion: emotion(감정)은 판단을 흐리게 하는 것이지 판단력 자체가 아님
❌ ④ memory: memory(기억)는 판단력과 다른 개념
det.tip: judgment = 판단력. your judgment is clouded by emotions가 본문 단서

questions.passage: The mind has parts that are __________ (know) as the conscious mind and the subconscious mind. The subconscious mind is very fast to act and doesn't deal with emotions. It deals with memories of your responses to life, your memories and recognition.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: be known as(수동) — know의 과거분사 known
det.analysis: 'parts that are __________ as'에서 be동사 are 뒤에 수동태를 완성하는 과거분사가 필요. be known as = ~로 알려져 있다. know의 과거분사는 불규칙 변화로 known. know → known
det.tip: be known as ~ = ~로 알려져 있다 (know-knew-known)

questions.passage: You can choose whether __________ (carry) on a thought or to add emotion to it. When your judgment is clouded by emotions, this puts in biases and all kinds of other negativities that hold you back.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로 쓰시오)

det.korean: whether + to부정사 — to carry (뒤의 to add와 병렬)
det.analysis: 'choose whether __________ on a thought or to add emotion'에서 'whether + to부정사' 구조이며, 뒤의 to add와 or로 병렬을 이루므로 to carry가 적절. carry → to carry
det.tip: whether to + 동사원형 (to carry ... or to add 병렬)

questions.passage: The mind has parts that are known as the conscious mind and the subconscious mind. The subconscious mind is very fast to act and doesn't deal with emotions. It deals with memories of your responses to life, your memories and recognition. However, the conscious mind is the one that you have more control over. You think. You can choose whether to carry on a thought or to add emotion to it and this is the part of your mind that lets you down frequently because— fueled by emotions— you make the wrong decisions time and time again. When your judgment is clouded by emotions, this puts in biases and all kinds of other negativities that __________. Scared of spiders? Scared of the dark? There are reasons for all of these fears, but they originate in the conscious mind. They only become real fears when the subconscious mind records your reactions.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: hold you back=당신을 저지하다/방해하다 — 편견과 부정적인 것이 하는 역할
det.analysis:
❌ ① set you free(자유롭게 하다): 방해하는 부정적 맥락과 반대
❌ ② move you forward(전진시키다): 방해와 반대
❌ ③ calm you down(진정시키다): 부정적 영향과 다름
✅ ④ hold you back(저지하다/방해하다): 원문 일치. 편견과 온갖 부정적인 것이 당신을 '저지한다'는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: all kinds of other negativities that hold you back — 당신을 저지하다

det.korean: clouded by emotions=감정에 의해 흐려진 — 판단이 흐려질 때 편견이 생긴다
det.analysis:
❌ ① guided by pure logic(순수한 논리에 이끌린): 편견을 만드는 맥락과 반대
❌ ② based on clear facts(명확한 사실에 근거한): 편견 발생과 반대
✅ ③ clouded by emotions(감정에 의해 흐려진): 원문 일치. 판단이 감정에 의해 '흐려질' 때 편견과 부정적인 것이 자리 잡는다는 맥락에 부합 ←정답
❌ ④ supported by evidence(증거로 뒷받침된): 편견 발생과 반대
det.tip: When your judgment is clouded by emotions — 판단이 감정에 흐려질 때
